item.title: [AAPL Neutral (+0.14)] California State Teachers Retirement System Grows Position in Skyworks Solutions, Inc. $SWKS
item.description:

item.title: [NVDA Neutral (+0.14)] Broadcom: Sideways for Nearly Two Months After Earnings, Is Now a Buying Opportunity?
item.description:
Sentiment: NVDA Neutral (+0.14)
Broadcom's stock has traded sideways for nearly two months despite strong earnings, primarily due to unmet market expectations for more aggressive AI growth guidance and concerns over Google TPU supply share. The company's fundamentals remain robust, driven by AI semiconductors, stable traditional chip businesses, and predictable cash flow from its VMware-led software segment. Analysts suggest the current price consolidation offers a strategic entry point, contingent on continued realization of AI growth, particularly regarding Google TPU share, new customer adoption, and AI networking demand.

item.description:

However, Intel must prove its advanced nodes can meet performance and yield requirements to capitalize on TSMC's supply bottleneck and rising prices.
